items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: This was before King Oliver and all those came up. King Oliver and the bands that King Oliver played...

ctx.x: Tom got a nice ride up there.

He deserved credit. Well, he was, in reality, a pioneer in the jazz field. And there was other colored bands that were up there. This was before Louis Armstrong came up there. This was before King Oliver and all those came up. King Oliver and the bands that King Oliver played, and Armstrong, when they first come up to New Orleans, it wasn't a Dick's land combination at all. They had violins, they had flutes, and they had about eight, ten, twelve men, so you understand. And they played regular music at all the…
Yeah, Oliver, I think, got there about 1918, she saw it. And you say Papa Lane had mostly just the brass band. Mostly the brass band. And didn't do much dance work. No.
